privacy_scope.public_kb: Contains source-attributed project concepts, requirements, architecture and author/project-history passages from all 164 V14 pages. There is no author-only panel: all prototype sections and knowledge-search results are visible to visitors. All imported records remain candidate_not_authoritative; source attribution does not mean external verification.
privacy_scope.user_queries: The v4 AI interface does not persist user questions in its project knowledge database.
privacy_scope.external_provider: Each Gemini Interactions API request sets store=false to disable server-side Interaction storage. The user question and selected knowledge snippets are still transmitted to Google for processing; Google Search grounding may query public web sources. Provider service/security processing remains subject to Google's terms.
